slides.text: Space Is A Bending Four Dimensional Spacetime Continuum
slides.speech: Einstein proved in the twentieth century that physical space is not flat, but a curved four-dimensional continuum bent by gravity. For centuries, brilliant minds debated its real nature. In 1687, Isaac Newton claimed space exists as an absolute, permanent container independent of matter. Gottfried Leibniz argued space is merely a network of relationships between objects, similar to family ties. René Descartes declared that pure empty space cannot exist, while eleventh-century polymath Alhazen and Immanuel Kant argued space is an internal framework our brains use to organize experience.
